text:
leo-partnerships: Heads up 1: GreenBay Labs sent a redistribution addendum for their new 9B model. They want cloud marketplace listings (AWS/GCP) and optional appliance bundle SKUs. Theyre asking for a coordinated embargoed announcement. Can legal/ops/product/hw flag any blockers?
kevin-legal: Quick read: their draft includes a non-commercial line and a requirement to republish derivative packaging under CC-BY-SA. That blocks commercial marketplace and bundled appliance distribution. Need express commercial redistribution grant + carve-out for our packaged artifacts.
samir-ops: Ops needs to verify provenance before ingest: signed_manifest.json, SHA256 of weights tarball, OpenPGP fingerprint for signature, and S3 staging path w/ KMS policy if encrypted. Also require allowed_regions in manifest for geo-blocking.
maya-product: Marketplace metadata ask: SKU id(s), short description (<=180 chars), tags (quantized/9B), model family, latency bucket, pricing tiers, owner contact, README URL. Recommend separate SKUs for SW-only and HW-bundle.
owen-hw: For appliance bundle: need firmware compatibility statement and export/firmware restriction line from provider. Hardware validation is ~4 business days. Prefer distinct SKU for bundle.
leo-partnerships: Can we accept CC-BY-SA?
kevin-legal: Only if provider signs an addendum carve-out that exempts our distribution artifacts and bundled images from share-alike obligations. Otherwise not acceptable.
samir-ops: Technical enforcement notes: entitlement token required for bundle provisioning; manifest should include allowed_regions: ["US","EU","CA"]; require provider to PGP-sign weights and include fingerprint. We'll run malware scan + pre-quantization test.
maya-product: Timeline: provider wants announcement week of Jun 1 with embargo lift Jun 2 09:00 PT. If we receive signed addendum + artifacts by May 10, product+ops can complete listing and QA by May 28. Legal needs 2 business days after final addendum. HW validation must start by May 20 for bundle.
leo-partnerships: Action items: 1) Leo to request signed_manifest + fingerprint today (due Apr 28) 2) Kevin to draft addendum v2 with carve-out & Exhibit A (due May 6) 3) Samir to prepare ops checklist and entitlement flow (due May 10) 4) Maya to pre-draft SKU/readme templates (due May 6) 5) Owen to schedule HW validation (start May 20)
kevin-legal: Draft attribution line for listing: "Model by GreenBay Labs; inference served by Redwood Inference." Keep it short.
samir-ops: I'll open infra ticket and attach the ingest checklist. Require provider to PGP-sign and include key fingerprint in manifest.
owen-hw: ack 1 booked validation window May 20-24.
announce-bot: Note: joint-announcement draft will be created after signatures and validations pass.
leo-partnerships: Thanks team 1. I'll update thread when I have the signed_manifest and providers acceptance of addendum v2.
